Browser Media I/O 0.5.0 — MP3 module
https://github.com/cityedge/browser-media-i-o/tree/b55de4966e9cfd1dc0141adbb708fcfeccc20017
MIT wrapper; includes modified @breezystack/lamejs 1.2.7 (LGPL-3.0).
Authors: Alex Zhukov, the LAME project and fork contributors.
The MP3-only bundle does not include Mediabunny or the AAC encoder.

Narration Tempo modification (2026-10-22): exported encodePcmSource accepts an
asynchronous block reader, validates returned PCM and awaits each read.
The encoder itself is unchanged. This enables bounded reads from a retained Blob.
Modified wrapper: vendor/mp3-async.ts. Rebuild: vendor/rebuild.mjs.
Corresponding MP3-only source/build inputs are included in vendor/mp3-source/.
Install tools there with npm ci, then run vendor/rebuild.mjs and build.mjs.
Replace vendor/browser-mp3.js and run node Narration_Tempo/build.mjs to relink.
No signing key or runtime download is required.

Corresponding upstream sources and build inputs:
https://github.com/cityedge/browser-media-i-o/releases/tag/v0.5.0
https://github.com/cityedge/browser-media-i-o/blob/b55de4966e9cfd1dc0141adbb708fcfeccc20017/third_party/lamejs/source.tar.gz
https://github.com/cityedge/browser-media-i-o/tree/b55de4966e9cfd1dc0141adbb708fcfeccc20017/third_party/lamejs/extensions
https://github.com/cityedge/browser-media-i-o/blob/b55de4966e9cfd1dc0141adbb708fcfeccc20017/scripts/prepare-lamejs.mjs
The upstream source archive, extensions and build script are included locally
in vendor/mp3-source/. See SOURCES.md for rebuilding and replacement.
Preserve source availability when sharing.
